title: Trained on Harm, Still Refusing: A Training-Time Defense for Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning enables safety-aligned code language models to adapt to diverse downstream tasks. However, training on untrusted data can severely undermine their ability to refuse harmful requests. Notably, we find that models comply with harmful requests even though harmfulness information remains highly decodable from their internal representations. Moreover, an initial preference for refusal does not necessarily translate into sustained refusal behavior throughout generation. Together, these findings reveal a critical gap between recognizing harmful requests and consistently refusing to fulfill them. To address this gap, we introduce SAFEHOLD, a novel provider-enforced defense framework that preserves safety alignment during harmful fine-tuning by treating refusal as a sustained generation process rather than a single response decision. Specifically, SAFEHOLD preserves the aligned model's full-vocabulary response distribution at the init

translated_title: 在有害数据上训练，仍然拒绝：一种面向代码生成的训练时防御方法
translated_abstract: 微调使安全对齐的代码语言模型能够适应多样化的下游任务。然而，在不可信数据上训练会严重削弱其拒绝有害请求的能力。值得注意的是，我们发现即使有害性信息在其内部表示中仍然高度可解码，模型仍会遵从有害请求。此外，最初的拒绝偏好并不一定会在整个生成过程中转化为持续的拒绝行为。这些发现共同揭示了识别有害请求与持续拒绝执行之间存在的关键差距。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了SAFEHOLD，一种新颖的由提供方强制执行的防御框架，它将拒绝视为一个持续的生成过程而非单一的响应决策，从而在有害微调期间保持安全对齐。具体而言，SAFEHOLD在初始化阶段保留对齐模型的全词表响应分布……
tldr: 提出SAFEHOLD防御框架，将拒绝行为建模为持续的生成过程而非单次决策，使代码语言模型即使经过有害数据微调仍能保持拒绝有害请求的安全对齐能力。
en_tdlr: SAFEHOLD is a provider-enforced training-time defense that treats refusal as a sustained generation process rather than a single decision, preserving safety alignment in code generation models even when they are fine-tuned on harmful untrusted data.
